mapper.sql: t.id, t.root_run_id, t.parent_run_id, t.child_run_id, t.child_conversation_id, t.context_id, t.source_agent_id, t.source_release_id, t.target_agent_id, t.target_release_id, t.delegate_alias, t.depth, t.state, t.idempotency_key, t.request_digest, t.request_json, t.result_json, t.usage_json, t.error_code, t.error_message, t.deadline_at, t.version, t.created_at, t.completed_at
mapper.insert: insert into ai_a2a_task (id, root_run_id, parent_run_id, child_run_id, child_conversation_id, context_id, source_agent_id, source_release_id, target_agent_id, target_release_id, delegate_alias, depth, state, idempotency_key, request_digest, request_json, deadline_at, created_at, updated_at) values (#{task.id}, #{task.rootRunId}, #{task.parentRunId}, #{task.childRunId}, #{task.childConversationId}, #{task.contextId}, #{task.sourceAgentId}, #{task.sourceReleaseId}, #{task.targetAgentId}, #{task.targetReleaseId}, #{task.alias}, #{task.depth}, #{task.state}, #{task.idempotencyKey}, #{task.requestDigest}, cast(#{requestJson} as jsonb), #{task.deadlineAt}, #{task.createdAt}, #{task.createdAt})

insert into ai_conversation (id, user_id, org_id, title, agent_key, agent_version, agent_release_id, manifest_digest, status, root_conversation_id, parent_conversation_id, conversation_kind) select #{task.childConversationId}, c.user_id, c.org_id, #{title}, #{agentKey}, #{agentVersion}, #{task.targetReleaseId}, #{manifestDigest}, 'ACTIVE', coalesce(c.root_conversation_id, c.id), c.id, 'A2A_CHILD' from ai_conversation c where c.id = #{parentConversationId}

insert into ai_run (id, conversation_id, user_message_id, actor, actor_roles, actor_auth_version, question, agent_key, agent_version, agent_release_id, manifest_digest, model_key, status, priority, idempotency_key, policy_version, trace_context, parent_run_id, root_run_id, delegation_depth, a2a_task_id, a2a_context_id, dispatch_mode, runtime_instance_id, lease_owner, execution_token, lease_until, deadline_at, started_at) select #{task.childRunId}, #{task.childConversationId}, #{messageId}, r.actor, r.actor_roles, r.actor_auth_version, #{question}, #{agentKey}, #{agentVersion}, #{task.targetReleaseId}, #{manifestDigest}, #{modelKey}, 'DISPATCHING', r.priority, #{task.idempotencyKey}, r.policy_version, r.trace_context, r.id, #{task.rootRunId}, #{task.depth}, #{task.id}, #{task.contextId}, 'PARENT_LOCAL', r.runtime_instance_id, r.runtime_instance_id, 1, #{leaseUntil}, #{task.deadlineAt}, now() from ai_run r where r.id = #{task.parentRunId}
mapper.select: select from ai_a2a_task t where t.id = #{id}
select from ai_a2a_task t where t.id = #{id} for update
select from ai_a2a_task t where t.parent_run_id = #{parentRunId} and t.idempotency_key = #{key}

select count(*)::integer as total, count(*) filter (where delegate_alias = #{alias})::integer as matching_alias, count(*) filter (where state in ('SUBMITTED', 'WORKING', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED'))::integer as active from ai_a2a_task where parent_run_id = #{parentRunId}
select coalesce(sum(coalesce((usage_json ->> 'totalTokens')::bigint, 0)), 0)::bigint from ai_run where root_run_id = #{rootRunId} or id = #{rootRunId}
select count(distinct root_run_id)::integer from ai_a2a_task where root_run_id != #{rootRunId} and state in ('SUBMITTED', 'WORKING', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED')
mapper.update: update ai_a2a_task set state = #{state}, version = version + 1, updated_at = now(), result_json = cast(#{resultJson} as jsonb), usage_json = cast(#{usageJson} as jsonb), error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, cancel_requested_at = case when #{state} = 'CANCEL_REQUESTED' then now() else cancel_requested_at end, completed_at = case when #{state} in ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELED', 'REJECTED') then now() end where id = #{id} and version = #{version} and state in ('SUBMITTED', 'WORKING', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED')
mapper.insert: insert into ai_a2a_task_event (id, task_id, seq, type) values (gen_random_uuid(), #{taskId}, #{seq}, #{type})
mapper.select: select t.id from ai_a2a_task t join ai_run r on r.id = t.child_run_id where (t.state in ('SUBMITTED', 'WORKING', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED') and r.status in ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')) or (t.state in ('SUBMITTED', 'WORKING') and r.status = 'CANCEL_REQUESTED') or (t.state = 'SUBMITTED' and r.status = 'RUNNING') order by t.updated_at, t.id limit #{limit}

select t.id, t.parent_run_id, t.child_run_id, t.child_conversation_id, t.delegate_alias, target.component_key as agent_key, release.manifest_json ->> 'displayName' as agent_name, t.state, t.depth, t.request_json ->> 'task' as task_summary, t.result_json ->> 'summary' as result_summary, coalesce((t.result_json ->> 'truncated')::boolean, false) as truncated, t.error_code, t.error_message, t.usage_json, case when child.last_heartbeat_at is not null then child.started_at end as started_at, t.completed_at, coalesce((t.usage_json ->> 'durationMs')::bigint, (extract(epoch from t.completed_at - t.created_at) * 1000)::bigint) as duration_ms from ai_a2a_task t join ai_run parent on parent.id = t.parent_run_id join ai_run child on child.id = t.child_run_id join ai_agent_component target on target.id = t.target_agent_id join ai_agent_release release on release.id = t.target_release_id where parent.conversation_id = #{conversationId} order by t.created_at desc, t.id limit #{limit}

select child.id from ai_run child join ai_run parent on parent.id = child.parent_run_id where parent.status in ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED') and child.status in ('DISPATCHING', 'RUNNING') order by child.created_at, child.id limit #{limit}
